'''March 2001 Huntsville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL on 10 March 2001. Clay won it. It is known from Tom Culpepper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1884">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10d1884/ damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10], DeckTech (Tom "Gand" Culpepper, 12 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10d1884/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' Clay
